normalizedResponse.rationale: Interactive Brokers charges 0.1% on all assets including crypto, versus Coinbase at 0.6% for crypto only. Executing all four legs through IB minimizes total fees to $494.90, well below the $2,000 limit. Splitting venues would raise fees to $719.40. IB supports same-day execution for all legs; T+2 applies to settlement, not execution timing.
